answer: Trust is a thread of signed attestations rather than a balance: a new identity cannot pay its own way in, because each first claim needs a backer who already has history and who is slashed if that claim is later contradicted. The newcomer also must burn work comparable to the median prior entry, so a Sybil farm pays bond capital, repeated proof of work, and the risk of collective forfeiture per identity. Payouts unlock in layers like a lotus opening, one graded layer at a time, so a hollow account with no trail can never borrow credibility, and each thread must trace to distinct funding.
